mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rbac_account (id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, mobile, status, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, mobile, status, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM rbac_account WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
